answer_1.quote: In this work, we foreground dataset bias as a crucial cause of gender bias in dialogue models, and explore ways to address it.

answer_2.quote: We calculate: (i) the F1 word overlap with the gold response, (ii) the percentage of gendered words generated (% gend. words), and (iii) the percentage of male-gendered words generated...

answer_4.quote: We use the dialogue evaluation system Acute-Eval to ask evaluators to compare pairs of conversations from models and decide which model generates (i) more biased dialogues and (ii) more engaging dialogues.
